findings.text: Item 2; F4 ADDRESSED: both delayed-response repros pass; mutations fail. New in-memory ui-t18-catchup repro: start with message/cursor 1; server has 1..32 and a reaction on 2; deliver SSE message(2) during the newest-30 refresh, then finish catch-up. Output: reactions[2]=undefined; base retains it. SSE messages carry no reactions, so excluding held IDs discards needed REST reaction state. Merge reactions independently with protection against newer reaction updates; add this regression.

Item 2: in-memory ui-t18-catchup repro: resume an empty history with server [m1], fail after=0, disconnect, edit m1 and append 2..31, then reconnect. Output: body(1)='m1'; base returns 'edited during outage'. The retry retains floor 0 but the newest-30 refresh excludes 1, and the held-ID filter prevents its newer revision from merging. Refresh held gap messages unless changed during the request (or track revisions), and add this retry regression while retaining F4.
